title: T7: CLI Goals Namespace Implementation
description: Walkthrough of the new hlx goals CLI namespace with 4 subcommands (create, list, get, terminate)

steps.title: Goals namespace router
steps.description: The main entry point for `hlx goals`. Exports `runGoals` which dispatches to 4 subcommands via a switch statement. Follows the exact pattern from src/tickets/index.ts. For `get` and `terminate`, extracts goalId as a positional argument and validates it's present.

steps.title: Create command (POST /api/goals)
steps.description: Handles `hlx goals create`. Uses requireFlag for --title and --description (required). Optional flags: --repos (resolved via resolveAllRepos), --max-children (parsed to int), --require-approval (boolean), --sprint. Calls POST /api/goals with basePath '/api'.

steps.title: List command (GET /api/goals)
steps.description: Handles `hlx goals list`. Passes --status as server-side query param. Applies --limit as client-side Array.slice (server doesn't support pagination). --json outputs JSON.stringify. Table format: id-abbr, status (padEnd 18), child count, updated, title.

steps.title: Get command (GET /api/goals/:id)
steps.description: Handles `hlx goals get <goalId>`. Displays detailed Goal info: title, status, max children, approval mode, latest evaluation, child tickets, roadmap, and description. Handles null fields gracefully. --json outputs raw server response.

steps.title: printGoalDetail helper
steps.description: Exported helper that formats Goal detail for console output. Handles null latestEvaluation, null roadmap, empty childTickets arrays. Truncates description at 500 chars. Available for reuse by other commands.

steps.title: Terminate command (POST /api/goals/:id/terminate)
steps.description: Handles `hlx goals terminate <goalId> --verdict <complete|failed>`. Validates verdict against VALID_VERDICTS before API call. Uses requireFlag for --verdict. Error handling follows create.ts pattern with JSON body extraction.

steps.title: Goals registered in main CLI router
steps.description: The `goals` case in the main switch statement, following the exact `tickets` pattern: configOrHelp(args.slice(1)) then await runGoals(config, args.slice(1)). Import at line 11.

steps.title: Goals documentation section
steps.description: Added Goals section to Common Commands with command table, flag tables for all 4 commands, and 5 worked examples. Added 'goals' to keywords array for search indexing.
